_comment: Closes CG-2 (resurrected stale values in the paper's prose; the defect class that let
the invalid commit ef645ce pass a green gate; pushed by review n21, item 6).
Each entry lists the exact stale STRING(S) as they appeared when illegitimate,
why the value is stale, where it was retired, and an optional per-entry allow_regex:
a hit is PERMITTED when its line also matches the entry's allow_regex (default below),
because the paper legitimately cites retracted values when explaining the retraction.
Append an entry for every future stale-value finding; the registry is the ratchet.
